npu-engine.note: native, open-source, default NPU route as of 2026-07-20 (no FastFlowLM subprocess dependency). Single-core GEMM kernels correctness-verified on real hardware (docs/GEMM-KERNEL-CORRECTNESS-CONFIRMED.md); throughput numbers without a reproducible source in this repo are deliberately not published here — see docs/wiki/performance.md.

releases.name: FastFlowLM Fully Replaced + Model-Agnostic Engine
releases.description: FastFlowLM (AMD's closed-source NPU runtime) fully reverse-engineered and replaced with a native open-source XDNA 2 stack, now the default NPU route. GGUF architecture support 2→8, quant support 4→13. TQ2 (2-bit ternary) format implemented — the project's actual 1-bit storage path. Full Zyphra model family + 1BP conversions published to Hugging Face. Qwen2-VL vision POC.

releases.name: 1bit Coding Agent v2026.07.02
releases.description: Full pi.dev-compatible CLI: chat, install/remove/list/update packages, config, NPU stack management, extensions, skills, themes, systemd service.

releases.name: NPU Engine v12
